gates.passes: The error model of the callable is not none.
gates.why: {callable} cannot fail
gates.remedy: give {callable} an error result

gates.passes: The error model of the callable is last-return, so a failed call returns its values beside the error.
gates.why: {callable} returns no value when it fails
gates.remedy: remove the classification, because a failed call of {callable} returns no value

gates.passes: The callable has no mixin waits, so a call on a fresh subject returns without the call of another callable.
gates.why: {callable} waits for the call of another callable on a fresh subject
gates.remedy: remove the mixin waits where {callable} returns on a fresh subject

gates.passes: The partner mode of the claim binds exactly one callable of the declaration.

gates.passes: Each parameter of the read is a parameter of the write with the same name and type, a field of the written value with its name and type, the context, or a function, or the write takes no input.

gates.remedy: align the name of the parameter of the read with a parameter or a field of the write

gates.passes: The written value has a field that the read does not select by, so a second write can change what the read returns.

gates.remedy: write a value with a field that the read does not select by
